correctness.rationale: For A=u phi and B=v psi with phi(u)=psi(v)=0, [A,B]=alpha u psi-beta v phi. Both cross coefficients zero yields 0; exactly one nonzero gives rank-one square-zero; both nonzero gives rank-two split semisimple image span(u,v) with eigenvalues ±alpha beta. Counting normalized image lines/covectors gives zero Z, nilpotent rank-one 2q^{n-1}(q^{n-2}-1), rank-two fibers 2(q-1) in odd characteristic and q(q^2-1) in characteristic 2. Direct count of target populations and mass N^2 checks normalization, including n=2 where no rank-one output exists.
